cmd: cd /opt/weather-tg && curl -sf -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/scripts/weather_tg_review.py -o r.new && mv r.new weather_tg_review.py && grep -c wind_speed_unit weather_tg_review.py; echo CRONFILES; ls /etc/cron.d; grep -rl "weather_tg" /etc/cron.d /etc/crontab /var/spool/cron /etc/systemd/system 2>/dev/null; echo ROOTCRON; crontab -l 2>&1 | head -30; echo TIMERS; systemctl list-timers --all 2>/dev/null | grep -i "weather\|tg" | head; echo FIND_DONE
